# Spanish Private E‑Invoicing Platforms — API Capability Assessment for a Platform → Sage Integration
This assessment examines the **public API documentation** of **B2B Router, SERES, Banqup, and ZeroComa** so Sage can judge what it must expose for each platform to integrate *into* Sage (platform → Sage). Findings are graded **DOCUMENTED** (official public source), **INFERRED** (indirect/third‑party evidence) or **NOT FOUND**, and separated into **AVAILABLE TODAY** vs **PLANNED/ANNOUNCED** for Spain's B2B (SPFE) model. Spain evidence is prioritised; non‑Spain evidence is labelled.

## Headline findings first
![](data:image/png;base64,)

**Cross‑cutting SPFE caveat (applies to capability 8 for all four).** Spain's mandatory B2B regime runs under Law 18/2022 (Crea y Crece), Royal Decree 238/2026 and Orden HAC/1028/2026 (in force 6 Oct 2026), applying **6 Oct 2027** (>€8M turnover) and **6 Oct 2028** (everyone else), with status/payment reporting from 2029.[3](https://www.vatcalc.com/spain/spanish-b2b-crea-y-crece-e-invoice-approved-july-2027-28/) [63](https://e-invoicing.org/spain/) The **SPFE** is the universal mandatory repository; invoices sent via a private platform must transmit a **faithful copy in UBL** simultaneously to AEAT.[3](https://www.vatcalc.com/spain/spanish-b2b-crea-y-crece-e-invoice-approved-july-2027-28/) AEAT published SPFE developer documentation and, on 22 November 2026, draft validation rules.[3](https://www.vatcalc.com/spain/spanish-b2b-crea-y-crece-e-invoice-approved-july-2027-28/) [2](https://news.kworia.com/en/spain-s-ley-crea-y-crece-mandatory-b2b-e-invoicing-guide-2027-29) Because this regime is not yet operational, **no platform can be "submitting to SPFE today"** — all SPFE submission capability is **PLANNED/ANNOUNCED**. VERI*FACTU (anti‑fraud software reporting, from 2027) is a *separate* obligation that some platforms already automate today.[62](https://www.fiskaly.com/e-invoicing-profile-spain)

The diagram below maps the eleven capabilities onto the integration boundary Sage must design against.

![](data:image/png;base64,) *Figure 1: The eleven integration touchpoints Sage must consider when a Spanish private e-invoicing platform connects into Sage (platform → Sage), including the planned SPFE faithful-copy obligation and Peppol connectivity.*

## Platform 2 — SERES (Grupo SERES / Docaposte, Spain)
Public pages are **marketing**; the operating platforms (**e‑Factura.NET / SERESNET "EFactura EDI"**) are **login‑gated**, and no developer/API reference is public. The "Integración Servicios Web SERES" PDF that surfaces in search is a **different, unrelated SERES** (the SEDIPUALB@ citizen‑registry system) and is **excluded**.[39](https://estaticos.dipualba.es/seres3/IntegracionServiciosWebSERES.pdf)

| Capability | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
1. Auth & multi‑company | API auth scheme **not published**. Platform is ASP/B2B with per‑company accounts and signature models (manual/automatic, local/centralised), but no token/OAuth/cert API doc. | NOT FOUND (partner access required) | [38](https://facturaelectronica.seresnet.com/) [36](https://miacceso.e-factura.net/)

2. Company onboarding | Onboarding is sales‑led ("déjanos tus datos"); NIF captured in training/registration flows. No documented provisioning API or identifier schema. | NOT FOUND (partner access required); INFERRED NIF use | [35](https://www.groupseres.com/e-factura) [37](https://www.groupseres.com/area-formacion)

3. Sending invoices | Platform sends invoices (app "Envía tu primera factura"); no public endpoint style, sync/async model, or response schema. | NOT FOUND (partner access required); INFERRED capability | [37](https://www.groupseres.com/area-formacion)

4. Receiving invoices | Reception supported at product level ("recepción de la factura"); delivery mechanism (push/pull) for integrators not documented. | NOT FOUND (partner access required); INFERRED | [37](https://www.groupseres.com/area-formacion) [31](https://www.peppol.nu/supplier/seres-en/)

5. Status & lifecycle | "Notification agents" (alerts, acknowledgements, conformity) and **Track2Pay** status tracking described; no documented status enum, webhook security, or retry model. | INFERRED (official notes + partner ABAST); NOT FOUND (technical detail) | [36](https://miacceso.e-factura.net/) [30](https://www.abast.es/automatizacion-de-procesos-y-rpa/factura-electronica-con-la-solucion-e-factura-de-seres/)

6. Cancel & correct | No public documentation of cancellation/rectification via API or workflow. | NOT FOUND (partner access required) | —

7. Formats | **XML, PDF (graphic mark); UBL, Factur‑X, Peppol BIS, Facturae**; multi‑format conversion marketed. (Format breadth partly via third‑party directory.) | INFERRED (third‑party) + DOCUMENTED (XML/PDF official) | [31](https://www.peppol.nu/supplier/seres-en/) [36](https://miacceso.e-factura.net/)

## NOT FOUND — concrete questions to ask each provider
**B2B Router** (most is public; confirm edges):

- Does any **SPFE faithful‑copy submission endpoint** exist or is it on your roadmap, and what is the planned payload/UBL profile and timeline?

- Please confirm the **authoritative issued‑invoice state enumeration** and transitions returned by the API (our list is from third‑party connectors).

- Inbound **delivery guarantees** (ordering, de‑dup window, max retry duration) beyond the ~1‑week webhook retry — any SLA?

**SERES** (API docs are partner‑gated — most items below are NOT FOUND publicly):

- Is there a **REST/SOAP/EDI API reference** for sending/receiving, and is it public or partner‑only? Auth model (certificate, API key, OAuth)?

- **Company provisioning** API and identifier schema (NIF, DIRe, Peppol IDs)?

- **Status model**: list of states, how updates are delivered (webhook vs polling), webhook signing/retries (Track2Pay internals)?

- **Cancellation/rectification** support via API; **error code catalogue** and resubmission model?

- **Sync vs async** sending and acknowledgement payloads; sandbox availability?

### Reading the evidence (so proposals don't become facts)
- **DOCUMENTED** = official public page/spec. **INFERRED** = indirect or third‑party (e.g., Peppol directories, BC/Zoho connectors, partner pages) — treat as a lead to confirm, not a fact. **NOT FOUND** = not publicly verifiable, usually behind partner/login.

- **TODAY vs PLANNED**: only VERI*FACTU/SII/FACe and generic send/receive are "today". **All SPFE (Crea y Crece B2B) submission is PLANNED** (2027/2028) for every provider — the public solution and validation rules are still being finalised by AEAT.[3](https://www.vatcalc.com/spain/spanish-b2b-crea-y-crece-e-invoice-approved-july-2027-28/) [2](https://news.kworia.com/en/spain-s-ley-crea-y-crece-mandatory-b2b-e-invoicing-guide-2027-29)

- **Geography**: Banqup's richest country‑specific API is **France/AFNOR**; do not read it as Spain support. SERES operates in both Spain and France (separate PA registration in France).[1](https://seres.fr/en/electronic-invoice-page/)
